about.title: About Anubadak (অনুবাদক)
about.overviewBody: Anubadak translates between English (en), Bengali (bn), and Spanish (es) across all six language directions via a FastAPI backend connected to the hosted MyMemory Translation API.
about.limitsBody: Each translation request supports up to 500 UTF-8 bytes. Because Bengali Unicode characters occupy 3 bytes each in UTF-8, the byte counter tracks exact UTF-8 byte usage alongside character count. Daily request volume is subject to the upstream provider's free-tier policy.
about.speechBody: Anubadak inspects your browser's real Web Speech API voices (bn, bn-BD, bn-IN) at runtime. It never substitutes an English or Spanish voice to read Bengali text. Whenever a browser or operating system does not expose a native Bengali voice, the Listen button for Bengali is honestly disabled with a clear explanation.
